# SD18 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1..level-13 spontaneous spell-burden baseline
# (tests/sd18_sorcerer_level13_widening.rs) to Sorcerer level 14 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-13 fixtures, and the same canonical bloodline and
# bloodline class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge [arcana]), adding only
# the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bloodline feat selection, no bloodline
# bonus spell selection, no spellbook, no which-spells-known selection, no
# spontaneous-casting execution, and no level-15+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Sorcerer class table's level-14 "Special" column is genuinely blank (no
# new class feature), verified independently against d20pfsrd and
# legacy.aonprd.com (both identical; a third fetch against aonprd.com's
# level-13 row was internally inconsistent with the already-landed level-13
# truth and was rejected as a tool artifact per established practice, not
# treated as a genuine conflict). This is the first genuinely new
# spell-level column opening in the level-14 sweep: the Sorcerer's 7th-level
# spells first become accessible at level 14, so this fixture also exercises
# the newly widened base-spells-per-day and spells-known arrays.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level14-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:14
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
